messages.subject: HX-218 impurity — expert evidence in Hartwell v Tessaract
messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Dr Iqbal,

Following your confirmatory report on the HX-218 impurity, we anticipate instructing you as the Claimant's expert in analytical chemistry/GMP in the proceedings. Under the court's directions, reports are to be exchanged by 30 October 2026 with a joint statement by 27 November. Could you confirm your availability and whether you foresee any conflict? We'll send formal instructions and the agreed list of issues shortly.

Kind regards,
Elena Marchetti

--
Whitfield Carter LLP, 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.

messages.plaintextBody:
Dear Elena,

I confirm availability and no conflict. The characterisation work we did points firmly to a process-related degradant consistent with an unqualified starting material, so I'm comfortable with the scope. Send the issues list and I'll provide a fee estimate and timetable.

Faisal Iqbal
Wraysbury Materials Laboratory
